sections.heading: Buying ipe decking
paragraphs: Ipe Decking is one of the wood product forms available for sourcing through Rarewood Exchange. Board width, thickness, length mix and edge profile determine how a decking order is priced and installed. Specify grooved or square-edge boards and share the fastening plan.

A request for ipe should identify the product form as well as the species. The written quote should specify the actual material, measured dimensions, condition, quantity and delivery terms so the offered lot can be compared with your project requirements.

buyingChecklist: Delivery ZIP, timing and unloading access

faqs.question: How do I request a price for ipe decking?
faqs.answer: Include the dimensions, quantity in linear feet, intended use and destination ZIP. Those details allow material and delivery costs to be quoted for the same requirement.

faqs.question: Can I review the actual material before ordering?
faqs.answer: Ask for current lot photographs and a written description of dimensions, condition and any defects. For an individual slab, request images of both faces and measurements of its usable area.

faqs.question: Who confirms availability and takes payment?
faqs.answer: The selected supplier confirms the material and commercial terms, issues the customer invoice and receives payment. Rarewood Exchange coordinates the sourcing inquiry and may earn a commission on a completed sale.

specifications.note: Specifications, quantity and availability are confirmed for the offered material in the supplier quote.

applications.title: Exterior decking
applications.text: Share the dimensions and material requirements for your exterior decking project. The supplier can identify which offered pieces or lots match those requirements.

shipping.title: Define the order
shipping.text: Include the required ipe decking dimensions, quantity in linear feet, destination ZIP and target date. Identify any acceptable alternative sizes.

shipping.title: Confirm freight and unloading
shipping.text: The supplier confirms packaged dimensions, weight and pickup readiness. Delivery planning includes truck access, a dock or forklift, appointment requirements and any special unloading arrangements.

shipping.title: Receive and inspect
shipping.text: Check the delivered pieces against the written order and document visible damage before signing delivery paperwork. Follow the supplier’s handling, storage and acclimation guidance for the material and its intended use.
